description: Scikit-learn text classification behind the OVOS pipeline API using the jurebes 'nb_bernoulli' baseline: binary word count featurizer + Bernoulli Naive Bayes.
model: nb_bernoulli (binary word count featurizer + Bernoulli Naive Bayes)
notes: Same engine as every other jurebes fighter, different featurizer x classifier recipe (registry baseline 'nb_bernoulli', group(s): naive_bayes); single-stage pipeline at the plugin's own medium-confidence gate. The arena measures which sklearn recipe wins on assistant-style templates, not which fighter 'is' jurebes.
